labels.note: The value and quote are correct: the source states 'the starting water weight shall be at least 96.00 oz (2.721 kg)'. However, this requirement appears in section 9-2 Cooking (item c), not in 9-3 Dinner Party as the claim's conditions and section context assert. The Dinner Party section begins after Figure 9 and contains no water-weight requirement.

The source is Table 5-1 'Drivetrain Properties' listing rated rotor/generator speeds, gearbox ratio, generator efficiency and inertia, driveshaft spring/damping constants, and brake torque/time constant. The about statement accurately names these same categories (speeds, gearbox ratio, efficiency, inertia, driveshaft constants, brake specs) without quoting any numeric values or design decisions, and the stated role matches the caption's purpose.

The FFA-W3-211 77% span subplot shows a multi-material stacked layup on the Pressure Side (dominant black CarbonUD, plus green glass_triax, gray medium_density_foam, etc.), not a single material. glass_triax is only one of several legend materials present, so recording it as the 'material composition' treats one layer as the whole composition.

A is a deck-footing datum (GRADE LEVEL 0") from the HARVEST set (S-522), while B is a main/bedroom finished-floor height (2'-9 1/2" above grade) from the BOREALIS/Team Alberta building sections (A-303) — different Solar Decathlon designs, not one document. Because each project has its own grade datum, A's 0" datum does not establish the datum for B, so the stated rationale fails and the two are not complementary parts of one subject; they concern different buildings and different properties.

Figure 9 (in section 9-2 Cooking, not 9-3 Dinner Party as the context metadata says) shows the scoring curve flat at zero until the kink, then rising linearly to full points at 80 oz. The kink where the linear increase begins sits just left of the 20 tick, at 16 oz, matching the text ('between 1.000 lb (16.00 oz ...') and the legend ('Reduced points: 16 oz < Weight < 80 oz'). The claim reads the start of the linear rise as 20 oz, which is the nearest tick mark, not the actual kink at 16 oz; the quoted x-axis label does not support the value.

A is the NREL 5-MW steady-state pitch angle (23.47°) at 25 m/s from Table 7-1, where rotor speed is the NREL rated 12.1 rpm (P0 = 5.296610 MW). B is the IEA 15-MW pitch-controller objective (hold 7.55 rpm) for 10.59–25 m/s. These are different turbines (12.1 rpm vs 7.55 rpm rated) and different attributes (a pitch-angle operating point vs a control objective), so they are not complementary information about one corresponding controller; the rationale's 'same entity/same controller' is false.

The highlighted table row reads 'Young's modulus, steel E 2 00E11 Pa', where '2 00E11' is the table's rendering of 2.00E11 (matching the same format as 7.93E10 and 7.85E3 in adjacent rows). The claim's entity (steel), attribute (Young's modulus), value (2.00E11), unit (Pa), and quote all match the source faithfully.

Figure 2-6 shows the blade cross section at 70% span (section 0.7) with a materials legend listing Medium Density Foam, Glass Triax, Glass Biax, Carbon UD, Glass Uni, and Gelcoat. 'Carbon UD' does appear in the legend, so the text is present, but it is only one of several materials making up the section — stating the section's material composition as 'Carbon UD' alone overstates one legend entry as the whole composition.

The source's STRUCTURAL ENGINEER block lists BOB ALLISON, PE / ARUP ENGINEERING / 1120 CONNECTICUT AVENUE, NW., SUITE 200 / WASHINGTON, DC 20036 / TEL: 202.729.8220. The claimed address matches this text exactly (line breaks collapsed), and it is correctly bound to the Structural Engineer entity, not the MEP Engineer (which shares the same address) or the Architect.

The highlighted text states 'K_I(θ = 0º) = 0.008068634' exactly as claimed, with the condition θ = 0º attached. The source gives no unit for K_I (units 's' and 's²' attach to K_P and K_D respectively), so the unitless value is faithful. The quote is verbatim and the value matches digit-for-digit.

The chart (Figure 10) and the accompanying text both show that a net electrical energy balance of 0 kWh earns full points, plotted as 100 on the y-axis ('Points at conclusion of Energy Balance Contest'), so the value 100 at 0 kWh is faithful. The 'quote' is not verbatim text from the source; it is stitched together from the two axis labels with the values appended. Marking the reading approximate is acceptable since it is read from a chart, though the text confirms 100 exactly for >= 0 kWh.

The figure (Figure 10) is a graph titled 'Scoring function for the Energy Balance Contest' plotting points earned against net electrical energy in kWh. The about statement accurately describes this subject and relationship without stating specific threshold values, and the keywords capture the main topics. The role field does cite the -50/0 kWh range, but the about statement itself is clean and informative.

The source table in Figure 9 does state 'No points: Weight ≤ 16 oz (450 g)', so the value, unit, and quote are faithful. However, Figure 9 is the scoring function for the Cooking Subcontest under section 9-2 Cooking, not 'Contest 9-3' (Dinner Party) as the claim's conditions and section context state — the 9-3 heading merely appears below the figure in the highlighted region. The core fact is right but the contest/scope condition is misattached.

Detail E6 (ROOF BEAM @ GRID 2,3,4) shows a vertical dimension chain at the web opening reading 2" / 6" / 2" from top to bottom; the upper 2" is the clear distance from the beam's top edge down to the top of the 6"-tall opening (with 2" below it). The claim's entity, value 2", and 'from top edge' reading all match the drawing.

The drawing labels the finished floor elevation as "FINISHED FLOOR 2' - 9 1/2"" (above GRADE LEVEL 0'-0") on both the South and West elevations. The claim records the value as 2 ft, dropping the 9-1/2 inches, and its supporting quote reads "2' - 3"", which does not match the source text. The value is misread and the quote is not verbatim.

The sheet is titled BUILDING SECTIONS (A-301) and contains two labeled sections: SECTION - WEST MODULE and SECTION - EAST MODULE, with FINISHED FLOOR and GRADE LEVEL elevation markers visible. The about statement correctly names the subject (building sections), the scope (East and West modules), and the elevation references, and it does not quote the actual elevation values or any design decision.

The highlighted crop shows empty REFERENCE KEYNOTES and SHEET KEYNOTES columns alongside title-block text; the quoted row "C1 3/16\"" does not appear there. On the S-701 page, C1 is used as a detail callout ("MODULE B - PV STRUCTURAL MEMBER"), and no legible table row gives C1 a thickness of 3/16", so the value is not supported by the shown region or page.
